notes:
Continue watching on Home follows your Plex profile's own Continue Watching, and resuming uses whichever is newer: where you stopped in a Plex app or in StreamMate.

Live movies and shows on Home, Movies and Shows find their on-demand copies, including older titles in large libraries. Ways to watch shows how far you got and offers a movie that's already underway on live TV from the beginning.

To skip Ways to watch, choose Open on demand under Settings > Interests & discovery. Press and hold a poster to pick live instead.

On-demand tags say VOD. A poster with several ways to watch gets a pill in their colors: red for live, your accent color for coming up, teal for VOD.

Movie and show pages show the title's logo, take their background color from the art, and fade the art in below the status bar.

With a parental PIN set, movies, episodes, catch-up and recordings that are locked or blocked for a child profile ask for it. Search leaves out movies and shows in hidden and locked categories. Locks are still picked from channel groups, so Plex libraries can't be locked yet.

Category buttons in Movies and Shows appear only when there's more than one category.
